maria (sec): Quick SOC2 question — auditor asked for 'network enclave diagrams' + 'VPC flow log samples' for Private deployments. Which artifacts should we include?
jen (compliance): We have a standard network diagram PDF and an S3 path with VPC flow log exports. Auditor also asked for 'retention settings' screenshots.
alex (infra): For on-prem we provide an airgap export package + sanitized topology. For VPC customers we can export CloudTrail + VPCFlowLogs + ACL configs. I can pull a week of logs as CSV.
ryan (auditor): For scoping I need: 1) network diagram showing boundaries/trust zones; 2) sample VPC flow logs (7 days); 3) retention policy screenshot(s); 4) proof that KMS keys were used to encrypt backups (key IDs + snapshot manifest). PDF/CSV ok.
maria (sec): On KMS: auditor asked for 'key usage proof' and rotation history. Do we have a manifest linking snapshot IDs -> KMS key ids and rotation events?
alex (infra): Yes. We can produce a CSV: snapshot_id,kms_key_name,encrypt_operation_ts,principal. Example query to find encrypt ops: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.Encrypt"' --limit=1000`
jen (compliance): We also have a rotation schedule doc and rotation playbook PDF — I'll include that in the bundle.
ryan (auditor): Rotation playbook is fine. For crypto I may ask for KMS attestation if HSM-backed keys are in use. If customer BYOK for Private, show key import records and the KMS config + who can manage keys.
maria (sec): For RBAC: auditor wants 'who can encrypt/decrypt' for prod keys. Is an IAM policy export + mapping CSV sufficient?
alex (infra): Yes — export IAM policy bindings, list least-priv roles, and include a CSV mapping principals->permissions. Also include a short access log extract showing a recent admin key use (redacted principal IDs ok).
ryan (auditor): :thumbsup: Add the BreakGlass / emergency access process and any BreakGlass incidents this quarter.
maria (sec): Plan: network diagram (PDF), VPC flow log sample (7d CSV), retention screenshots, KMS usage CSV, rotation playbook, IAM export + mapping CSV, BreakGlass log. Anything else?
ryan (auditor): Include SHA256 hashes for each artifact and a README crosswalk mapping artifacts -> SOC2 control IDs (e.g., CC6.1, CC7.2). Also indicate which artifacts are redacted and where full originals reside.
jen (compliance): I'll draft the README with the control crosswalk and artifact naming conventions. Quick Q: for air-gapped on-prem we can't upload raw logs — will an attestation + hash be ok?
alex (infra): Yes — acceptable approach is a signed attestation from on-prem ops + the SHA256 of the full log set stored on-site. Provide verifier steps (how to re-hash).
maria (sec): Great. I'll start packaging. @ops-bot can you trigger a snapshot export for a test private tenant so we have concrete artifacts to show?
ops-bot: Snapshot export job queued: job_id=job-2026-03-21-001, ETA ~8m.
maria (sec): Perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
